scamAlert.title: If you already sent money to a scammer
scamAlert.body: Contact your mobile wallet provider (bKash/Nagad/Rocket) immediately with the transaction ID. File a report with local police for significant amounts. Then notify us at info@smartliving.bd with screenshots so we can block the account.

about.title: About Smart Living
about.description: We are building a modern living system for Bangladesh — from discovery and booking to rent, bills, and day-to-day communication.
about.intro: Whether you are a student in a mess, a professional in a flat, or a traveller needing a guest house, Smart Living brings listings and management into one consistent experience. This web app is frontend-first: data is mocked like API responses so we can plug in a real backend without rewriting screens.

allInOne.title: All-in-one
allInOne.text: Mess, hostel, apartment, and short stays in one place — built for how Bangladesh actually rents.

trustByDesign.title: Trust by design
trustByDesign.text: Verification, clear billing, and owner–renter tools reduce scams and WhatsApp chaos.

fairForBoth.title: Fair for both sides
fairForBoth.text: Renters get transparency; owners get structured rent, notices, and records.
